description: This file is a shell script used to test various functionalities involving git worktrees, submodules, and related configurations. It defines a set of test scenarios including repository setup, worktree management, submodule updates, and configuration checks.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified directory with provided changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario that must succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test scenario that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or contents and checks for equality.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the provided input is empty.
